summary: PS Canada Finance ULC, a consolidated Public Storage subsidiary, filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of C$-denominated senior notes due 2033, fully and unconditionally guaranteed jointly and severally by Public Storage and Public Storage Operating Company. Principal amount, coupon and offering price are left blank in this preliminary filing; notes pay semi-annual interest beginning 2027, are unsecured and unsubordinated, redeemable at PS Canada's option (including for tax reasons), and are sold privately in Canada to accredited investors/permitted clients via CDS book-entry in C$2,000 minimums. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no pricing terms are yet stated.
